input.task_description: Create a FastAPI POST health-check endpoint. The endpoint should be defined in a new file named 'healthchek.py' located at 'e:\Hackathon\buddy-agent\test'. The endpoint should respond to POST requests at a suitable path (e.g., '/health-check') and return a simple JSON response indicating the service is healthy, e.g., {"status": "ok"}. Include necessary FastAPI imports and create an APIRouter if appropriate.
